title: Enforce isAllowlisted() on narrations and playlists mutations and regenerate firestore.rules

violation.problem: match /narrations/{narrationId} and match /playlists/{playlistId} currently authorize create, update, and delete using only isOwner(...). A non-allowlisted or revoked Firebase Auth user can bypass profile creation and directly create or mutate narrations and playlists.
violation.expectedSolution: Require `isAllowlisted()` on `create`, `update`, and `delete` in both `match /narrations/{narrationId}` and `match /playlists/{playlistId}` in `studio/firestore.modules.rules`, and regenerate `studio/firestore.rules` via `npm --prefix studio run rules:build:firestore` so the compiled artifact includes `function isAllowlisted()`.

requiredPatterns:
allow create: if isAllowlisted()
        && isOwner(request.resource.data.ownerUid)
        && hasRequiredNarrationFields()

allow update: if isAllowlisted()
        && isOwner(resource.data.ownerUid)
        && immutableFields(['ownerUid', 'createdAt'])
        && validNarrationFields();

allow create: if isAllowlisted()
        && isOwner(request.resource.data.ownerUid)
        && hasRequired(['ownerUid', 'title', 'description', 'narrationIds', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt'])
